library.label: Video library
library.title: Submissions & lesson recordings
library.intro: Videos are watermarked per viewer and streamed in the browser, and every view is logged.
library.introWithWhatsapp: Videos are watermarked per viewer and streamed in the browser, and every view is logged. WhatsApp uploads land here automatically once a teacher sends a video with the right caption code.

state.transcoding: Transcoding in progress. Refresh in a minute or two.
state.received: Received. Waiting for the worker to pick it up.
state.failed: Transcode failed. Contact your programme admin.

detail.notice: Your name and the time are shown over this video, and every view is logged. Playback links expire within a few hours. Please do not share, download or re-record classroom videos.

externalEmbed.unsupported: Unsupported external URL. <link>Open in a new tab</link>.

uploads.label: My uploads
uploads.title: Submit a lesson video
uploads.intro: Send it over WhatsApp or upload it here — whichever works on your network today.

attachNotice.done: Attached. The video now shows where you chose.
attachNotice.invalid: Choose what to attach the video to.
attachNotice.refused: The video could not be attached there. Choose another place.
attachNotice.not_attachable: Only your own videos that are not linked yet, and have not failed, can be attached.
attachNotice.locked: Unlock that section first, then attach the video.

cards.whatsappExact: Send your video to {phone} with the caption {caption}. Fastest on 2G/3G.
cards.whatsappCode: Send your video to {phone} with your cycle code as the caption, e.g. OBS-2026-009. Fastest on 2G/3G.
cards.uploadBody: Choose a file below. Resumes on disconnect. Max file {maxMb} MB. We'll transcode to HLS automatically.

uploads.locked: That link is for the {section} section. <link>Unlock {section}</link> to upload to it.

choose.label: What is this video for?

unlock.observation: Unlock Observation to choose a cycle
unlock.mentorship: Unlock Mentorship to choose a meeting or a quarterly video

choose.otherHint: Linked to nothing: only you and programme administrators will see it.

slowLink.title: On a slow 2G/3G link?
slowLink.body: Send the video to {phone} on WhatsApp with your cycle code as the caption, e.g. OBS-2026-009.

recent.title: My recent uploads
recent.count: {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} · most recent first
recent.emptyHint: Use one of the options above — WhatsApp is the fastest on a flaky connection.

error.quarterOnly: A quarter applies only to a mentee's quarterly video.
error.chooseCycle: Choose which observation cycle this video is for.
error.cycleSignedOff: This cycle has been signed off. Its record is closed, so no more evidence can be added.
error.chooseMeeting: Choose which meeting this recording is for.
error.closedPairing: This pairing is complete. Its record is closed, so no more videos can be added.
error.choosePairing: Choose which mentorship pairing this video is for.
error.chooseQuarter: Say whether this is the Q1 (baseline) or the Q4 (endline) video.
error.q4NotYet: The Q4 video is recorded in the pairing's last quarter; this pairing is in Q{quarter}.
error.chooseSubject: Choose which RTT subject this teach-back is for.

title.generic: Not linked to a cycle, meeting or pairing

audience.cycle: It goes on the cycle's Evidence, where the teacher, the observer and the mentor review it.
audience.meeting: It goes on that meeting in the pairing, for the mentor and the mentee.
audience.quarterly: It goes on the pairing page, for the mentor and the mentee.
audience.teachBack: It goes to the teach-back queue, where mentors and observers review it.
audience.private: Only you and programme administrators can see it.

option.quarterlyQ1: Q1 baseline video for your mentor
option.quarterlyQ4: Q4 endline video for your mentor
option.cycleStatus: Cycle {status, select, nominated {nominated} pre_submitted {pre submitted} observed {observed} post_submitted {post submitted} complete {complete} other {{status}}}

actions.notConfigured: Uploads are not configured on this deployment. Please contact your administrator.
actions.locked: Unlock that section first: enter its password, then send the video again.
actions.tooLarge: That file is larger than the {mb} MB limit. Send it over WhatsApp instead.

complete.storage_unavailable: Storage did not answer. Your video is uploaded; try confirming it again.
complete.object_missing: We could not find the uploaded file. Please try again.
complete.object_truncated: The upload finished early and is incomplete. Please try again.
complete.object_too_large: That file is larger than it was declared and was refused.
complete.not_found: That upload could not be found.

error.not_configured: Uploads are not configured on this deployment.
error.library_unavailable: Upload library unavailable. Please send the video over WhatsApp instead.
error.signed_out: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.connection_dropped: The connection dropped. Reconnect and choose the same file to resume.
error.too_large: That file is too large. Send it over WhatsApp instead.
error.refused: The server refused this upload. Send the video over WhatsApp for now, and tell your programme admin.
error.session_expired: Your session expired during the upload. Sign in again and retry.
error.failed: Upload failed. Please try again, or send the video over WhatsApp.

upload.unconfirmed: Your video is uploaded, but we could not confirm it with the server. Check your connection and tap Retry; it will not upload again.

failure.signed_out: Your session has ended. Sign in again to keep watching.
failure.no_access: You no longer have access to this video. Reload the page to check.
failure.unavailable: This video is not available right now. Tell your programme admin.
failure.generic: Playback failed. Check your connection and reload the page.
failure.unsupported: This browser cannot play these videos. Open this page in an up-to-date Chrome, Firefox or Safari.

player.notProduced: Not produced: videos stream at up to 480p

modal.title: Two ways to send a lesson
modal.whatsappIntro: The fastest path on a slow connection. Forward your video to the programme number with one of the caption codes below. It lands in this library automatically once the worker finishes transcoding.

caption.obs: Caption OBS-'<'code'>' — attaches to an observation cycle (code from the cycle detail page).
caption.tb: Caption TB-'<'subject'>' — a teach-back for an RTT subject (Upload a teach-back video on the subject's page gives its code).
caption.mm: Caption MM-'<'uuid'>' — attaches to a mentor meeting.
caption.quarterly: Caption Q1-'<'uuid'>' or Q4-'<'uuid'>' — a mentee's quarterly video for her pairing.

modal.unlinked: A video whose caption has no code, or one you may not use, still arrives, but linked to nothing: only you and programme administrators can see it. Attach it from My uploads, or send it again with the right code.
modal.browserIntro: Resumable upload, MP4 / MOV / 3GP, transcodes to {quality} HLS after the upload finishes (set by the programme admin in system settings). Use this when you already have the file on disk (e.g. classroom recording).
modal.browserUnlinked: Uploaded here, a video is linked to nothing: only you and programme administrators see it. For an observation cycle, a meeting or a quarterly video, use <link>My uploads</link>, which asks what it is for.

tray.hint: MP4 / MOV / 3GP · resumable on network drop · 480p HLS transcode after upload
tray.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and choose the file again.

mobile.chooseIntro: Pick a way that fits your network today.
mobile.slowBody: WhatsApp is faster than direct upload on weak signals — your phone keeps retrying in the background.
mobile.previewIntro: Add a caption so your mentor knows what this is.
mobile.watermarkNotice: Whoever plays your video back sees their own name and the time over it — please do not redistribute outside the programme.
mobile.slowFallback: If your connection is slow, send via WhatsApp instead
mobile.doneBody: Transcoding now. It can be played once that has finished. Taking you to My Uploads…

error.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and tap Retry.
error.failedWhatsapp: Upload failed. Try again, or send the video over WhatsApp.
error.redirect: {error} — tap Back to return to My Uploads
error.unknownWhatsapp: Something went wrong. Try again or use WhatsApp.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
